_comment: PDF to Excel Converter – Configuration. All keys are optional; missing keys use built-in defaults.

_notes.table_extraction_method: auto tries pdfplumber → camelot → tabula in order
_notes.ocr_language: eng = English; fra = French; deu = German; chi_sim = Chinese Simplified. Install extra Tesseract language packs.
_notes.ocr_dpi: Higher = better OCR quality but slower. 300 recommended; 150 for speed.
_notes.ocr_confidence_threshold: 0–100. Only include OCR words above this confidence. 60 is a good balance.
_notes.header_color: Hex color (no #) for header row background.
_notes.alternating_row_color: Hex color (no #) for alternating data row shading.
_notes.tesseract_path: Full path to tesseract.exe on Windows if not on PATH. Example: C:/Program Files/Tesseract-OCR/tesseract.exe
_notes.java_path: Full path to java.exe if not on PATH. Required only for tabula-py.
